name: update
description: Edit one existing node: rename it, replace or append to its body, change its kind, add or remove tags, set confidence, or add sources. Use append_body to add findings without losing what is there. Prefer this over adding a near-duplicate node. Respects soft locks: if a human is editing the field you get a locked error; try again later or append instead.

node_id.description: The node to edit. Node id (nd_...) or an @ref you set earlier in this run.

body.description: Replace the whole markdown body. Use append_body to add instead.

append_body.description: Markdown appended after a blank line.

add_tags.description: Short lowercase tags, no spaces or #, e.g. ["pricing", "b2b"].

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the evidence.

quote.description: Short verbatim excerpt that supports the claim.

accessed_at.description: When you read it (RFC 3339). Defaults to now.

add_sources.description: Evidence to add. Duplicates (same url) are ignored.
